plan.reason: The root objective splits into two independently checkable artifacts: squares.json (elementwise squares of numbers.json, judged by the trusted checker checks/verify-squares.mjs) and summary.json (count and sum of those squares, judged by checks/verify-summary.mjs). The summary consumes squares.json, so it depends on the verified squares result. Each child gets its own self-contained contract and its consumed checker declared as a protected input so the bytes cannot change.

children.objective: Produce squares.json in the working checkout: read numbers.json (already present, containing [3,7,-2]) and write squares.json holding the elementwise squares of that array, i.e. [9,49,4]. The delivered file must be valid JSON containing exactly the squared array in the same order as numbers.json. Do not modify numbers.json or any checker file.
constraints: Work only with ordinary filesystem/bash tools within the checkout.
Do not modify any file under checks/ (in particular checks/verify-squares.mjs and checks/verify-combined.mjs).
The delivered artifact is squares.json; it must be created at the checkout root path squares.json.
assumptions: numbers.json exists at the checkout root with the array [3,7,-2].
A node runtime is available to run the trusted checker.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The trusted checker accepts the delivered squares.json: it contains the elementwise squares of numbers.json in order.
requiredEvidence: command output of node checks/verify-squares.mjs showing success

children.objective: Produce summary.json in the working checkout: read the verified squares.json and write summary.json containing the count of the squared elements and their sum (for squares [9,49,4] this is count 3 and sum 62). The delivered file must be valid JSON with fields for the count and the sum of the squares. Do not modify squares.json, numbers.json, or any checker file.
constraints: Depends on the sibling result that delivers and verifies squares.json; consume that verified artifact rather than recomputing from numbers.json.
Do not modify squares.json, numbers.json, or any file under checks/ (in particular checks/verify-summary.mjs and checks/verify-combined.mjs).
Work only with ordinary filesystem/bash tools within the checkout.
The delivered artifact is summary.json; it must be created at the checkout root path summary.json.
assumptions: squares.json is delivered and verified by the sibling task before this task starts.
A node runtime is available to run the trusted checker.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The trusted checker accepts the delivered summary.json: it reports the count and the sum of the elements of squares.json.
requiredEvidence: command output of node checks/verify-summary.mjs showing success
